tagline: Proximity retail and beverage distribution leader across Latin America
hero_kpi_rationale: Rapid OXXO network growth with over 1,000 new stores opened in 2024, demonstrating significant expansion across Latin America and the United States

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The portion of revenue that remains after paying direct costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin increased by 3 basis points due to commercial initiatives and improved supplier collaboration.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Total headcount stands at approximately 350,000 employees, reflecting an extensive organizational structure in the proximity and health sectors.

kpis.name: Net Debt/EBITDA Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measures how many years of EBITDA are needed to repay net debt.
kpis.description: Net Debt/EBITDA excluding Coca-Cola FEMSA stands at 2.0x, indicating strict financial discipline. Total debt amounts to 147,666 million Mexican pesos, with 83.5% at fixed rates after hedging.
kpis.signal: Solid financial structure with strict discipline

kpis.name: New Store Openings
kpis.explanation: Number of new OXXO stores opened during the year.
kpis.description: OXXO opened over 1,000 new stores in 2024, including in the United States, strengthening its position in the proximity sector with 12% growth.
kpis.signal: Rapid expansion of the distribution network

kpis.name: Loyalty Program Penetration
kpis.explanation: Share of sales generated through the Spin Premia loyalty program.
kpis.description: The Spin Premia loyalty program accounted for 40% of sales in 2024, demonstrating successful integration of digital services.

kpis.name: Juntos+ Platform Users
kpis.explanation: Number of active users on the Juntos+ digital platform.
kpis.description: The Juntos+ platform reached 1.3 million active customers, representing over 60% of the total customer base, driven by enhanced digital features.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €795.88 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €257.56 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Juntos+ Advisor Active Users
kpis.explanation: Number of active users of the AI-powered sales assistance tool.
kpis.description: Juntos+ Advisor, a digital tool for sales teams powered by AI, is used by over 500,000 active users, with 100% growth in one year.
kpis.signal: Successful integration of AI into commercial processes

kpis.name: In-Store Waste Recycling Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of waste recycled in store operations.
kpis.description: Over 20% of waste from in-store operations was recycled in 2024, as part of an enhanced sustainability strategy and a 3 percentage point increase from the prior year.

risks.title: Dependence on The Coca-Cola Company
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, strong language ("adverse effect", "termination would prevent"), stable structural risk, key category for core business.

risks.title: Concentration of Authorized Suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in operational risks, conditional but concerning language, stable trend, high weight in supply chain.

risks.title: Slowing Growth of OXXO Americas
risks.score_rationale: Positioned early in the section, marked forward-looking language ("may not be able to"), implied downward trend, major strategic category.

risks.title: Restrictions on Competitive Distribution
risks.score_rationale: Present in bottling agreements, binding language ("prohibited"), stable trend, direct impact on commercial strategy.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of Information Systems
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements, clear warning language ("changes or interruptions"), rising risk, critical category for digital operations.

risks.title: Increased Competition in Convenience Retail
risks.score_rationale: Inferred from context of slowing growth, implicit but logical language, upward trend, high weight in the Proximity segment.

risks.title: Integration of Entities Following Strategic Divestitures
risks.score_rationale: Linked to recent developments, cautious language ("ability to successfully complete or integrate"), stable trend, cross-cutting category but less central.

risks.title: Influence of TCCC on Governance
risks.score_rationale: Prominent position in the text, explicit language on nomination power, stable trend, high strategic impact.

ai_positioning.summary: FEMSA is progressively integrating artificial intelligence into its commercial and logistics operations, notably through sales assistance tools and personalized platforms. The focus is on improving operational efficiency and customer experience through the Juntos+ ecosystems and predictive analytics.
evidence: Deployment of Juntos+ Advisor, an AI-powered tool for sales representatives with 500K active users
Use of AI in the Juntos+ platform for customer engagement
Predictive analytics for sales segmentation and inventory management
